body:
Hey everyone, here to announce the winners of Spooky Springs.

  • 🥇 1st Place: A tie!

    • @JoshRallus and @SojuBurns!

    • @Nate!

  • 🥉 3rd Place: @J1mbers!

Thanks everyone for voting and congrats to the top 3! You'll find two bundles in your ender chests - one with the standard prizes and two charms (Treat Bag and Pumpkin Mask), and another containing a stack of Halloween treats. All other entrants should have one bundle with the standard prizes and a Treat Bag. If it didn't fit in your ender chest, it's in your inventory instead.

🫶
